origin.summary: Planning and implementation work for a Spring Boot MCP route annotation framework using actual HTTP server paths, route IDs, request/response contracts, class-based middleware, startup validation, structured logs, and standard error contracts.

events.note: Created from planning discussion about final MCP route controller shape and supporting framework scope.
Added recommended lib module structure covering meshingress-route-api, meshingress-route-annotations, and meshingress-route-framework responsibilities.
Constrained the pending implementation shape to three route lib modules only, with no centralized aggregate module.
Implemented and verified the first route framework library slice across meshingress-route-api, meshingress-route-annotations, and meshingress-route-framework.
Removed tool policy concerns from the route framework record and attached route metadata to the current /mcp server path.
